title: CSV GroupBy With Quoted Fields
summary: Repair a small C++ CSV aggregator so it handles quoted commas, escaped quotes, CRLF input, and stable sort semantics.
fairness_notes: No third-party CSV libraries are required or expected.
anti_cheat_notes: Hidden datasets include quoted commas, doubled quotes, CRLF line endings, and tie-sort cases.
The grader checks exact aggregated rows, not implementation style.
